coder_notes: Single-arm trial of fasting plus ketogenic diet (metabolic therapy program) on top of standard Stupp treatment. Diet and fasting are excluded intervention types. Temozolomide is listed because the arm text states every patient receives it; it is not a registered intervention. Magnesium supplement and multivitamin allowed during fasts not listed (supplements, not interventions). Registry phase is NA.
